submitted.rationale: XRD shows a rutile-type Fe-Sb oxide across the line, with a hematite second phase appearing on the Fe-rich side (idx 3 clearly, idx 8 as a trace). EQE rises as Fe increases: idx 22 (Sb-rich) ≈ 0, idx 12 (~1:1) 0.0056%, idx 8 (Fe0.66Sb0.34, rutile plus a trace of hematite, near the phase boundary) 0.0325%. That is the highest measured, so idx 8 is chosen.

rejected.reason: Single-phase rutile near FeSbO4, EQE 6x lower than idx 8
Not measured for merit. XRD shows a large hematite fraction; its EQE is unknown
